introduction: Montana WIC provides nutrition support for eligible pregnant or postpartum participants, infants and young children.
description: Montana WIC provides nutrition support for eligible pregnant or postpartum participants, infants and young children.

sections.who: Residency, income and nutrition screening apply. Ask the local clinic how current benefit enrollment affects the income test.
